n: Noughts and crosses AI demo with Machine Learning for Kids
t: A noughts and crosses demo where the computer opponent learns from every game played.
steps: Find the worksheet linked from the ml-for-kids GitHub repository.
Create a teacher account on Machine Learning for Kids.
Set up the pre-built Scratch project as the worksheet describes.
Check that the school network allows the site.
Play a few test games to see the opponent improve.
Plan how the model will be retrained during the event.
